content: ADK MCPToolset connects to MCP servers. Import: from google.adk.tools.mcp_tool.mcp_toolset import MCPToolset (or McpToolset). Requires google-adk[mcp] extra which brings mcp>=1.24,<2. For stdio local server: McpToolset(connection_params=StdioConnectionParams(server_params=StdioServerParameters(command='python3', args=['path/to/server.py']))). Include in agent tools list. Cleanup handled automatically by agent framework. tool_filter param optional for security filtering.
